S0464.reason: The equitable result is the goal of maritime delimitation, achieved by adjusting a provisional equidistance line based on relevant circumstances and proportionality.

S0473.reason: Hart distinguishes between being obliged (coerced) and having an obligation (normative), a key aspect of his legal theory.
